properties.name: Simpler.Host
properties.what: the app: WhatsApp, email and calendar, on your own computer
properties.runs: On your Windows computer. Free. The app itself sends Simpler nothing; records reach Simpler.Asia only when your AI uses a Simpler.Asia tool.

properties.name: Simpler.Asia
properties.what: the paperwork that runs the shop, done by your AI
properties.runs: On the web. The one place that keeps the business records: invoices, expenses, customers, stock and forecasts. It never messages your customers. Any AI can use it, and some steps wait for your approval.

properties.name: Simpler.Run
properties.what: check the rent and footfall before you sign the lease
properties.runs: In your browser. Singapore, corner by corner.

properties.name: Simpler.House
properties.what: drop a floor plan, get the schedule before anyone quotes you
properties.runs: In your browser. For anyone with a floor plan. The schedule follows how renovation is done in Singapore.

properties.name: Simpler.Tax
properties.what: your company’s bookkeeping and tax, in one place
properties.runs: On your Windows computer, for Singapore businesses. Sends nothing to Simpler. Prepares the forms, never files them.

properties.name: Simpler.Red
properties.what: take the names out before you paste into an AI
properties.runs: On your Windows computer. Open source. Nothing leaves the machine.

properties.name: Simpler.Legal
properties.what: swap the names in a legal document for tags, check them, then hand it to any AI
properties.runs: On your Windows computer. Open source. No account, and no Simpler server in the way.

properties.name: Simpler.Capital
properties.what: the planned money side of Simpler, not open today
properties.runs: A page. Nothing to call, nothing offered today. It links to every Simpler app that is live.
